title: Levels Post-Meal Glucose Spike Frequency
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports, Oura, WHOOP, Dexcom, Levels, LibreView, Eight Sleep, Withings, and Garmin Body Battery feeds via vendor APIs, exports, Home Assistant bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=levels:glucose event_type=meal_window
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count(eval(glucose_rise_mgdl>30)) as spikes, count as meal_windows by person _time
| eval spike_pct=round(100*spikes/meal_windows,1)
| where meal_windows>=5 AND spike_pct>40
| sort - spike_pct
description: Uses Levels CGM meal windows telemetry to monitor the share of meals that triggered a sharp glucose rise in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for food patterns that keep creating large excursions, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Levels CGM meal windows data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces the share of meals that triggered a sharp glucose rise so you can spot food patterns that keep creating large excursions before it becomes annoying.
